# Retro Medieval Kit

- Creator: Kenney
- Source: https://kenney-assets.itch.io/retro-medieval-kit
- Free download, official upload 12993664; downloaded 2026-09-24 UTC.
- 105 original GLB models extracted with textures and included text documents.
- Complete unmodified archive: `source/kenney-assets.zip` (excluded from Godot import).
- Archive SHA-256: `3575369035274195de8e0174046886b50930279e0944a313990a4c2524745960`.
- Publisher license statement: [LICENSE_SOURCE.txt](LICENSE_SOURCE.txt).
- Models and textures are unchanged; no gameplay integration.

In Godot, expand this folder in FileSystem and drag a `.glb` into a 3D scene.
Nature seasonal textures may need manual material assignment.
